name: SpaceWise: The Real Solar Syst
summary:
How far away is Mars, really?

JOURNEYS
Eight narrated chapters with subtitles, voiced by a natural-sounding, computer-generated British narrator. Stand under the real night sky at a mountaintop observatory, visit Hubble and Webb, watch a real solar flare, see the Pillars of Creation and fall into a spinning black hole. Every scene says what is a real image and what is a model or a picture.

EXPLORE
The Sun, all eight planets, Pluto, Ceres and 13 moons at their true sizes and distances, where they are today
